Seeing the world from
a runner's perspective.
en.intro: Not a professional athlete. Not a full-time travel blogger. Just a guy who enjoys running, exploring new places and occasionally questioning why he signed up for another race.
en.aboutTitle:
It started with karting.
It became a way of life.
en.aboutExcerpt: Cross-country skis, a snowboard, a few injuries, and an unlikely reason to start running. This is the story behind the miles.
en.aboutBody:
## A different starting line

I grew up in Estonia, where snowy winters made cross-country skiing a natural place to start. Snowboarding came next. It felt cooler, but it also brought injuries. Then, around eighteen, I was partying more and only occasionally getting to the gym. By 2018-2019, my weight had reached about 100 kg. I wanted to lose 20-25 kg for karting and motorsport. That was my reason to start running.

## Nine marathon attempts. Then a new focus.

My running story includes nine marathon attempts. Later, my focus shifted to the 10 km distance.

## Running with other people

I founded Rocca Sörk. Running had become something to share, as well as something to do for myself.

## Work remotely. Explore on foot.

I work remotely in digital marketing. When I travel, I run. This journal brings those parts of my life together: the personal story, the places, and the everyday act of putting on running shoes.

The destination pages collect the places where I have run. I will add my own notes, photographs and running experiences over time.

et.intro: Lumiselt Eestimaalt uutesse paikadesse. Lood jooksmisest, oma rütmi leidmisest ja maailma avastamisest joostes.
et.aboutTitle:
Kõik algas kardisõidust.
Sellest sai eluviis.
et.aboutExcerpt: Murdmaasuusad, lumelaud, mõned vigastused ja ootamatu põhjus jooksma hakata. Nii see teekond algas.
et.aboutBody:
## Kõigepealt tuli lumi

Kasvasin üles Eestis, kus lumine talv tegi murdmaasuusatamisest loomuliku valiku. Hiljem hakkasin lumelauaga sõitma. See tundus lahedam, aga tõi kaasa ka vigastusi.

## Teistsugune stardijoon

Kaheksateistkümneselt pidutsesin palju ja jõusaali jõudsin pigem harva. Aastateks 2018-2019 oli kaal kerkinud umbes 100 kilogrammini. Kardisõidu ja motospordi nimel tahtsin alla võtta 20-25 kg. Sellest sai minu põhjus jooksma hakata.

## Üheksa maratonikatset. Seejärel uus fookus.

Minu jooksuteekonda kuulub üheksa maratonikatset. Hiljem nihkus fookus 10 km distantsile.

## Jooksmine koos teistega

Asutasin Rocca Sörgi. Jooksmisest oli saanud midagi, mida tahtsin teistega jagada.

## Kaugtöö ja jooksutossud

Töötan digiturunduses ja teen kaugtööd. Reisides käin alati jooksmas. See päevik toob kokku minu loo, uued paigad ja lihtsa harjumuse jooksutossud jalga panna.

Sihtkohtade lehed koondavad paigad, kus olen jooksnud. Täiendan neid enda tähelepanekute, fotode ja jooksukogemustega.
